disposition_mapping.rationale: Claim submission survives as the employee's sole accountable act of origination (EXR-R-10), now enriched with embedded capture and a paper/scan fallback channel so the function does not depend on universal smartphone access or connectivity. The receipt-evidence input for above-threshold lines remains a hard gate at this step (EXR-R-01), satisfying the requirement at the point of entry rather than downstream. Actor separation from approval (EXR-R-03) is preserved because the employee remains the only actor in this step.

Receipt capture occurs at the point of submission (T1) rather than as a later, separate AP-analyst task, and extraction plus its verification/exception handling moves into the automated compliance agent and its resourced exception specialist (T2). This was flagged unconstrained_by_design and the council converged (with emerging_economy's dissent on universal manual verification held against by the majority, including finance_domain and agentic_architect) on confidence-gated automation with a named, resourced exception queue rather than universal re-keying or universal human verification of every extraction. The mechanical transcription function disappears; the data-quality assurance function persists in logged, escalatable form.

The policy compliance check survives (EXR-R-07) as a deterministic rules-engine evaluation against limits, categories and per-diem tables, now running automatically and consistently rather than depending on an analyst's memory of the current policy version. Non-compliant or ambiguous lines are not silently auto-passed or auto-corrected (KB-05); they route to a named AP exception specialist who sees the specific flag before the claim proceeds. This still completes strictly before line manager approval (EXR-R-02), preserved by construction since T2 is the sole input to T3.

The council was split between maximalist's exception-only auto-approval (manager engaged only for flagged claims, compliant claims approved against a delegated-authority profile) and the majority view (pragmatist, finance_domain, hitl_designer, agentic_architect, accounting_standards) that EXR-R-08's survival requirement means an affirmative human decision on every claim, even if lightweight for clean ones. This synthesis sides with the majority: a pre-configured rule approving a transaction the manager never looked at is a different, cheaper control than manager approval, not the same function surviving. The interface is restructured (one-touch for clean claims, forced engagement with specific flags for exceptions) but every claim still receives a contemporaneous human act, and actor separation (EXR-R-03) and the claimant-is-manager escalation rule are preserved.

Finance review is unconstrained_by_design, so narrowing from 100%-of-claims review to a documented, versioned risk-trigger is a legitimate redesign that every council member except maximalist endorsed. The council rejected two alternative dispositions: maximalist's full dissolution into the compliance agent and manager adjudication (coding correctness and evidence sufficiency are an accounting judgment distinct from business-purpose judgment and from mechanical rule-checking, per hitl_designer and accounting_standards), and accounting_standards' merge of finance review into the posting step (agentic_architect and hitl_designer's observability argument prevailed: the two functions have different triggers, different accountable actors, and merging them risks the urgent, high-volume posting-exception workload crowding out slower evidential-sufficiency judgment). Finance review therefore remains its own named, accountable, risk-triggered step.

Posting mechanics (account/cost-centre determination, transaction-date recognition, transaction-date FX translation) are automated as mechanical application of already-approved, already-reviewed data, consistent with KB-01 and KB-07. Transaction date and transaction-date exchange rate remain hard-required inputs (EXR-R-04, EXR-R-05), and the rate-sourcing mechanism is widened to accept locally captured or manually sourced official rates as a first-class path, not merely a fallback to a premium feed, per the council's concession on this point. The GL accountant is not removed: they retain the posting ruleset, period-cutoff enforcement (KB-03), exception handling, and — a gap the baseline left unassigned — explicit ownership of period-end accrual for incurred-but-unclaimed expenses (KB-01, KB-04). Exchange differences between posting-date and settlement-date rates are tracked separately rather than netted into the expense line (KB-08).

Reimbursement survives (EXR-R-09) and continues to depend on manager approval having occurred, enforced as a hard system gate (EXR-R-06). The council rejected maximalist's fully instant, single-digital-rail, no-batch design: hitl_designer's requirement for a human authorization checkpoint on new or changed bank details, and emerging_economy's requirement for channel-plural disbursement (cash/cheque alongside bank transfer) for unbanked populations, were both held firmly by multiple members and are adopted here as structural features of the target step rather than edge-case patches. Routine, unchanged-bank-detail claims can still be released quickly; changed-bank-detail claims and non-digital disbursement instruments are first-class, not degraded, paths. The payable's derecognition point (KB-11) remains clearly determinable because the payment-run line is still traceable to the specific posted claim.

Notification carries no judgment content and is correctly marked unconstrained_by_design; it is absorbed as a system-triggered event firing at the moment of payment completion. Consistent with the council's near-unanimous view, the only substantive change from baseline is that the notification channel is widened to include SMS alongside app/email so employees on basic handsets are not structurally excluded.

steps.description: The employee submits an out-of-pocket expense claim via self-service app or a paper/scan fallback channel, photographing or attaching receipts for claim lines above the receipt threshold at the point of entry. The employee remains the sole accountable initiator; no agent or other actor stands between the employee and the record of what was claimed. Channel plurality (app and paper/scan) is a first-class design requirement, not a degraded fallback, because smartphone and connectivity access is uneven across the workforce this process serves.
inputs: Receipts for claim lines above the receipt threshold (app photo or paper/scan upload)
steps.name: Claim submission with embedded capture
outputs: Submitted claim with captured receipt images

steps.actor: Compliance agent with AP exception specialist
steps.description: A compliance agent extracts structured data from receipt images, applies the expense policy ruleset (limits, categories, per diem rates) and produces a policy-checked claim record with a visible, versioned exception log. Clean, high-confidence claims pass straight through. Low-confidence extractions and policy exceptions route to a named, resourced AP exception specialist who sees the specific flag, the extracted data and the original image, and who makes a real accept/correct/escalate decision rather than auto-passing past a threshold. The specialist role is the redeployment destination for AP-analyst capacity previously spent on routine re-keying and line-by-line policy checking.
inputs: Submitted claim with captured receipt images
Expense policy (limits, categories, per diem rates)
Extraction confidence thresholds (calibrated per receipt-format population)
steps.name: Automated extraction verification and policy compliance check
outputs: Structured claim record (extracted data linked to original receipt images)
Policy-checked claim record with visible flags and versioned exception log

steps.description: The line manager takes an affirmative human action on every claim before it proceeds: a lightweight one-touch approval where the compliance agent found no issues, and mandatory engagement with the specific flag, amount and any claimant justification where exceptions exist. No claim is approved by a pre-set delegated-authority rule with no contemporaneous human act; the council majority held that this is the substantive meaning of the survival requirement, not merely an approver-of-record label attached after the fact. A claimant who is also the designated approver escalates to the next level up. Actor separation from submission is enforced structurally through access-control permissions, not by convention.
inputs: Policy-checked claim record with visible flags
steps.name: Line manager approval
outputs: Approved expense claim (manager's affirmative action recorded)

steps.description: A finance reviewer, distinct from both the compliance agent and the line manager, examines claims triggered by a documented, versioned risk policy: policy overrides, above-threshold amounts, cross-currency lines, or coding/evidence-sufficiency flags the compliance agent cannot resolve. This step is not folded into manager approval (the manager's judgment is business-purpose legitimacy, not accounting treatment) and is not folded into posting (finance's evidential-sufficiency judgment is adjudicative and must not be crowded out by the operationally urgent, high-volume posting-exception workload). It replaces a 100%-of-claims manual re-review with a narrower, auditable, risk-based one.
steps.name: Finance exception review
outputs: Finance-reviewed claim with recorded review outcome

steps.actor: GL accountant (posting agent with exception handling)
steps.description: A posting agent translates the finance-reviewed, approved claim to the correct expense account and cost centre, recognising it in the period in which the expense was incurred and translating foreign-currency lines at the transaction-date rate. Transaction date and transaction-date exchange rate remain structurally mandatory inputs regardless of automation, and the rate source may be a live feed or a manually captured/locally sourced official rate, provided it is the correct transaction-date rate and is logged. A GL accountant retains the posting ruleset, the period-cutoff gate, exception handling for unmapped cost centres or rate-source failures, and explicit responsibility for period-end accrual estimation of expenses incurred but not yet claimed. Corrections to machine-generated postings are made only through standard journal reversal entries, never silent edit or deletion.
steps.name: Automated GL posting with exception handling and accrual oversight
outputs: Exchange-difference entries where posting-date and settlement-date rates diverge

steps.description: The approved, posted claim is paid to the employee. Routine claims with unchanged bank details are released automatically once approval and posting have cleared; any claim involving new or changed employee bank details is held for explicit human authorization before funds move, closing a known fraud vector that upstream approval alone does not address. Disbursement remains channel-plural (bank transfer, cash or cheque) rather than a single digital rail, so unbanked or informally banked employees are not structurally excluded. Notification fires automatically on payment completion across app, SMS and email channels so employees on basic handsets are not excluded.
inputs: Employee bank details or alternate disbursement instrument
steps.name: Reimbursement and notification
outputs: Reimbursement paid (bank transfer, cash, or cheque)
